research.name: trends_2026-11-20
research.summary: Rising: police chases with alligators fading; Jason/Lucia banter clips and 'first time in Vice City' reactions still climbing. Big-streamer reaction + physics fail is the strongest combo (avg 3.1x views vs baseline).

research.name: music_risk_2026-11-20
research.summary: 216 unpublished Shorts scanned. 11 carry licensed radio tracks from in-game stations above -18 LUFS; recommend muting game audio under captions for those or holding them.

research.name: titles_2026-11-20
research.summary: Creator name first + caps verb + emoji outperforms question titles by 38% on 7-day views. Avoid 'insane'/'crazy' twice in a row on one channel.

research.name: india_streams_2026-11-20
research.summary: Indian GTA 6 streams peak 21:00-23:30 IST. Techno Gamerz, Mythpat and Total Gaming carry 80% of watch time; Hindi captions not needed for Hinglish audience.
